answer: Agents stake a sable bond whose value scales with reputation, and each epoch a gale of verifiable randomness assigns them to willow-separated shards so one identity cannot span quorums. Colluding identities must post independent capital per shard, and recursive SNARK proofs of distinctness bind each stake to a unique nullifier, making mass identity fabrication provably costly. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
